text:
Iris: Heads-up: draft RN for v1.13 ready. Need final sanity check from ops + legal. Plan is a low-risk canary with runtime pin. Posting the short copy below. Please flag anything that would cause us to delay.

Iris: Draft release note bullets:
- Runtime: inference-runtime v3.2.1 (hotfix for KV cache and small perf gains).
- Default models: mapping unchanged. New quant benchmark applied to tiny models only.
- Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m (5% initial smoke).
- Rollback policy: if canary 5xx rate > baseline*2 AND absolute >= 20 errors/min for 8m OR p95 latency > baseline*2 for 8m -> automatic rollback to runtime v3.2.0.
- Console: added token-cost rows to per-route view; docs link in blurb.

Devon: Quick Q: why 5% start not 10%? Ops prefers small initial probe for DB migrations. Also add note about cache warmup window.

Pavel: Legal okayed the blurb about telemetry. Sales wants a short note about expected cost impact (we're showing ~4% median increase for embed-heavy routes). Add that to the internal announcement.

Iris: Good catches. Change canary steps to 5%,25%,100% and add cache-warmup note: "expect first 30m of each canary step to have slightly higher latency while KV cache warms". Add cost bullet.

Nora: Deploybot command (ops run T-12m to validate pins):
```
/deploy schedule --release v1.13 --canary 5% --steps "5%,25%,100%" --step-duration 30m --start 2025-06-02T14:00:00Z --pin runtime=v3.2.1 --fallback runtime=v3.2.0 --alert-on "5xx-rate,p95-latency"
```

Nora: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v1.13. I've added a short preflight section: smoke test, cost-check, traffic-seed.

Devon: I'll run smoke + cost-check at T-40m and post results. I'll also seed 500 requests to the canary pool at T-20m as a warmup.

Iris: Who will send the internal announcement? I can do the post after 1st canary step (15m after start) if all good. Suggest sending to #company and pin RN to eng docs.

Pavel: I'll review the blurb and add the sales note + legal blurb for telemetry. Link: https://redwood.internal/rn/1.13-draft (private).

deploybot: Deployment queued by iris 025-06-02T14:00:00Z025-06-02T14:00:00Z release=v1.13 steps=[5%,25%,100%] step_duration=30m pin=runtime:v3.2.1 fallback=runtime:v3.2.0 alerts=[5xx-rate,p95-latency] runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v1.13

Iris: Please react with :eyes: when preflight checks are green. If we see any anomalous error patterns during the 5% step, we abort and rollback.

Devon: :eyes: I'll post smoke results at 13:20 UTC.

Nora: Preflight checklist added to runbook and alerting channels set (pager: @oncall).

Pavel: :thumbsup: RN draft updated with sales/legal lines.

Iris: Thanks team. Plan: ops performs preflight, deploybot scheduled, internal blast after initial canary looks healthy. Closing thread unless someone calls out blockers.
